name: newrelic
description: Query and troubleshoot New Relic from the terminal: read application logs and errors, run NRQL, check APM and browser data, and verify agent setup. Credentials come from the macOS Keychain or environment variables, never from a repo.

interface.longDescription: Query and troubleshoot New Relic from the terminal: read application logs and errors, run NRQL, check APM and browser data, and verify agent setup. Credentials come from the macOS Keychain or environment variables, never from a repo.
defaultPrompt: Show the latest errors in New Relic.
